trainingPrograms.name: Shitake Mushroom Training
trainingPrograms.description: Embark on an intensive 5-day journey into the specialized world of Shiitake mushroom cultivation, designed to transform novices into knowledgeable growers. You will begin by mastering the fundamentals of mycology and the hands-on process of sawdust block substrate preparation. From there, you'll learn the critical sterile techniques of inoculation, how to manage the precise incubation and fruiting environments, and the secrets to protecting your crop from contamination. As your practical skills grow, so will your business acumen, with sessions dedicated to the art of harvesting, post-harvest handling, and the essential economics of costing and marketing your product. The program culminates in a forward-looking session on business planning and value-addition, ensuring you leave with a complete roadmap for success in the lucrative field of Shiitake cultivation.

trainingPrograms.name: Oyster Mushroom Training
trainingPrograms.description: Embark on an intensive 5-day journey into the world of Oyster mushroom cultivation, designed to take you from novice to knowledgeable grower. You will begin by mastering the fundamentals of mycology and the hands-on process of substrate preparation. From there, you'll learn the critical, sterile techniques of inoculation, how to manage the delicate incubation and fruiting environments, and the secrets to protecting your crop from contamination. As your practical skills grow, so will your business acumen, with sessions dedicated to the art of harvesting, post-harvest handling, and the essential economics of costing and marketing your product. The program culminates in a forward-looking session on business planning, exploring value-added products and designing your own small-scale farm, ensuring you leave with a complete farm-to-market skillset and a clear roadmap for success.
